annotations.title: Get the top 10 services in a category ($0.05)

description: The top 10 best-measured live UseTested services in a category (inference|data|search|media|infrastructure), ranked by verdict tier + liveness-weighted reliability — evidence depth (≥20 settled calls), composite score (0.4 × liveness-adjusted reliability + 0.3 quality + 0.3 value; liveness scales reliability: ALIVE ×1.0, LIKELY ALIVE ×0.5). Only ALIVE/LIKELY ALIVE services qualify — AVOID, UNTESTED and DEAD are never included — and there is no paging: this is a best-of list, not the whole catalogue. Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client.
